$sources: MNBC 2020 Part 3 load combinations in the ASCE 7-05 Sec 2.3.2 / 2.4.1 form: the wind W of the 50-year basic wind speed at 1.6 in strength design and 1.0 in allowable stress design; E at 1.0 / 0.7
source: MNBC 2020 Part 3 load combinations (ASCE 7-05 Sec 2.3.2 and 2.4.1 form, as SAEngine reads MNBC's adoption): 1.4D; 1.2D + 1.6L + 0.5Lr; 1.2D + 1.6Lr + (L or 0.8W); 1.2D + 1.6W + L + 0.5Lr; 1.2D + 1.0E + L + 0.2S; 0.9D + 1.6W; 0.9D + 1.0E. D includes SD; F with the factor of D; H at 1.6 where it adds to the other loads. The seismic load effects (Ev, Ω0) and the rest are the parent's (ASCE 7-22 Sec 12.4, the same form).
